<h2>Resolve the sjSDM Tier Tuning Context</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies an optional configured resolution subset to a pipeline's default
tier-tuning context.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_sjsdm_tuning_context(
  list_default_context = NULL,
  resolution_ids = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_default_context">list_default_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named list describing the pipeline, resolution IDs, and store layout.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="resolution_ids">resolution_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional non-empty character subset of the default resolution IDs.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The validated tuning context with any configured subset applied.
</p>

</main>
